browse_dataset_original: browse a pose dataset in original mode to visualize raw images with keypoints and bounding boxes
browse_dataset_transformed: browse a pose dataset in transformed mode to visualize images after data transformations are applied
browse_dataset_save_output: browse a pose dataset and save visualization outputs to a specified directory instead of displaying
browse_dataset_select_phase: browse a specific phase of the dataset such as train, test, or val for visualization
browse_dataset_override_config: browse a pose dataset with overridden config options to customize dataset settings on the fly
